data.description: Business payload returned by the controller handler

fileType.description: Broad category of the file. Inferred from MIME type when omitted (defaults to DOCUMENT).

context.description: Legacy upload context hint from older clients. USER_FILE and similar values map to DOCUMENT when fileType is omitted.

mimeType.description: Standard MIME type of the file

threadId.description: Associated chat thread ID if applicable

uploadId.description: The unique ID assigned during the upload request

sourceMediaId.description: Private deliverable media ID to copy

purpose.description: Why this link exists — shown in admin and helps avoid reusing one link for everyone

expiresInSeconds.description: Link lifetime in seconds (required for new links; min 1 hour, max 90 days)

passwordProtected.description: Whether the link requires a password

password.description: The password required to access the shared media

allowedEmails.description: List of specific emails allowed to access

originalFilename.description: Override display filename shown in admin UI

metadataPatch.description: Arbitrary metadata patch merged into metadata JSON

uploadId.description: The unique ID assigned during initialization

etag.description: ETag returned by storage after uploading the part

password.description: Password for a password-protected share link
